thread:
elaine: Quick note: I built a minimalist Next.js + LlamaClient starter for evals (App Router). Wanted zero-config dev, but hit an auth/retry parity weirdness between runtimes. Posting details so we can patch the starter and file any SDK issues.
maria: Thanks. What happened?
elaine: On local dev everything worked because I had a dev-only fetch wrapper that refreshed a token on 401. On Vercel preview it didn't, so we saw 401 then a retry from the browser SDK that ended up double-processing some requests. Log snippet: ```edge-server | POST /api/run -> 401
browser-sdk | retrying (1) -> 200
edge-worker | processed run id=run_01
edge-worker | processed run id=run_01```
tom: Classic. Do we know why browser SDK retried on 401? That sounds different from node.
maria: Yeah, we recently added a legacy behavior where browser retries 401 to support silent token rotation for some customers. That is dangerous for idempotency. We should align runtimes.
nash: (typo) ash: Suggestion: in the starter, avoid embedding secret-handling in edge middleware. Instead show a server-side proxy route that sets the API key and adds an idempotency header. Example snippet I used: ```js
// app/api/invoke/route.ts
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid'
export async function POST(req){
  const id = req.headers.get('x-idempotency-key') || uuid()
  const body = await req.text()
  const res = await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_PROXY_URL + '/invoke', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-idempotency-key': id },
    body
  })
  return new Response(res.body, { status: res.status })
}
```
elaine: I'm updating the starter to include that proxy pattern, and to validate required env vars on boot with a clear message so people don't silently pass wrong keys.
ash: Also add a tiny note in README: "Edge runtimes and middleware may not have the same env mapping as serverless functions; prefer proxy routes for secrets."
maria: On SDK side, I'll open an issue to export a shared RetryPolicy type and default constants so examples can import the same policy across runtimes. Also we should make retryOn401 opt-in and default to false for browser/edge.
town: Can we also add a small test in starter e2e: assert single processing per idempotency key? CI has been flaky where retries cause duplicate records.
ci-bot: CI report: starters/e2e (preview) failed: tests/e2e/idempotency.spec.ts:14  duplicate run detected. Rerun passed. https://ci.internal/1999990001
maria: Good point. Elaine, can you add that e2e check and a note in the README checklist for eval harnesses: seed prompts, deterministic RNG, idempotency enabled, env var assertions?
elaine: Yup. I'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-starters/pull/372  fixes .env naming, adds proxy example, idempotency snippet, and README checklist.
nash: Small addition: include a one-line snippet showing client config to disable 401 retry: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, retry: { attempts: 3, retryOn: [429,502,503,504], retryOn401: false } })
```
maria: Thanks. Filing SDK issue to add RetryPolicy export and update default retry behavior across runtimes. Will link PR once done.
elaine: Marking as resolved for now. Will reopen if the PR causes any regression. :thumbsup:
